topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The ground felt different under my feet, looser, and the air held a scent I couldn’t quite place. I’d been digging, like I often do, searching for the familiar rustle of hidden treats. But today, the soil yielded something unexpected, something metallic and cold. I recognize my paws on it, the marks of my claws, yet the object itself feels foreign, as if it carries the whispers of a past I can barely remember. I brought it up, dusted it off, and now it sits here, watching me. I should have just left it buried, where it belonged. Now, everything feels a little too quiet, as if the forest is waiting for me to explain what I’ve done.
